method: Per AUDIT_PROTOCOL.md P2: prose claim -> G5-validated ledger anchor -> read current code -> verdict MATCH/DRIFT/NOT_FOUND, plus inverse sweep for undisclosed steps. No fixes. Evidence = verbatim prose line + file:line code chain.

withdrawn.reason: The finding misidentified the ESTIMAND. It assumed UncResCEO is a noisy proxy for a latent uncertainty shock (epsilon), so that the first-stage estimation error in the subtracted FE/controls would be 'measurement error' the 2nd-stage SE must absorb. That is wrong: UncResCEO is OPERATIONALLY DEFINED as the DWZ eq-4 residual -- the deviation from the estimated CEO baseline + controls IS the variable's definition, not error against a hidden true value (DWZ: 'UncRes represents the residuals from Equation 4 ... the potentially strategic component'). The thesis's inferential target IS this constructed measure ('the residual is elevated pre-announcement'), not a latent parameter. For a claim about an observed constructed measure, standard firm-clustered inference is valid -- exactly as the entire residual-measure empirical literature does (abnormal returns, discretionary accruals, residual dispersion, etc.). A generated-DV/regressor SE correction (Pagan 1984) binds only when the estimand is a latent quantity for which the residual is a proxy; the thesis makes no such claim. Therefore: NO defect, NO referee-exploitable gap. Fully withdrawn, not merely downgraded.
withdrawn.shared_miss_note: The advisor (Opus) ALSO endorsed MAJOR. This was a shared conceptual error on the estimand, not a transcription slip -- both the auditor and the reviewer model anchored on a latent-proxy framing the thesis never uses. Lesson for remaining P2 items: before grading any 'generated variable' concern, first pin the ESTIMAND (constructed-measure claim vs latent-parameter claim); the SE-correction question is moot for the former.
withdrawn.retained_for_referee_prep_only: Seed sec.7b's 'have a response ready' note may stay as referee-prep (if a referee insists on re-casting UncResCEO as a proxy for latent uncertainty, the one-paragraph answer is a two-stage bootstrap + the operational-definition point above). This is NOT a finding against the thesis and carries no severity.

findings.verdict: DRIFT-by-omission: the stated inference ('clustered by firm') is literally TRUE of the code but INCOMPLETE -- it omits that the dependent/independent object is an estimated first-stage residual whose estimation error is not carried into the reported SEs, and the thesis never discloses this.

econometric_assessment.note: Sign of the correction is NOT signed a priori for a generated DV. Do NOT claim the SEs are 'understated'.
econometric_assessment.h14c_h18_RHS_null: UncResCEO on RHS, coefficient under test = a NULL. Standard generated-regressor result (Pagan 1984 / Wooldridge): the variance-correction term is proportional to the coefficient under test, so under H0(coef=0) it vanishes and OLS inference is valid to first order. => the specific UncResCEO null is legitimate as reported. CAVEAT: ClarityCEO (= -CEO_FE) is ALSO a generated regressor in those tables, so only the UncResCEO null is clean, not the whole table.
econometric_assessment.analysis1_DV_headline: UncResCEO as DV; tested coefficient is on PreAnnounceQtr (a NON-generated treatment), so the under-null shortcut does NOT apply. Validity of the naive SE hinges on Cov(PreAnnounceQtr, first-stage regressors Z). Not cleanly orthogonal: the first stage carries firm controls (stock/market returns, earnings growth, surprise) that plausibly co-move with pre-deal quarters, plus CEO-FE/firm-FE and year-effect overlap across the two stages. Therefore naive SEs are NOT guaranteed valid -- but the direction is indeterminate. Defensible statement: 'uncorrected + undisclosed -> a two-stage bootstrap is required to know whether inference moves.'

findings.live_exposure: Exactly one cell: the headline positive significant generated-DV result, Analysis 1 PreAnnounceQtr on UncResCEO = 0.0461 (SE 0.0172). t approx 2.68; one-tailed 1% critical value 2.33 -> margin is real but not large. Every other UncResCEO result in the draft is either a null (h14c/h18, channel) where the issue is benign-to-favorable, or a validity check.
findings.severity_rationale: MAJOR not CRITICAL: no reported number is proven wrong; OLS point coefficients are consistent under both DV and RHS use; this is an undisclosed inference gap a finance referee will exploit (Pagan 1984), not a computational/transcription error. Not MINOR: it touches the headline result's significance and is a predictable referee lever.
recommended_response_FIX_SESSION_out_of_: Two-stage bootstrap (resample firms; re-run first stage + second stage) to report corrected SEs for the Analysis-1 generated-DV result; confirm the 1% star survives.

findings.title: Tail convention is non-uniform across tables (disclosed + justified, not a defect)
findings.finding: One-tailed (beta>0) for directional-positive hypotheses (Analysis-1 treatment, cash_scrutiny_validity, reason_gating); two-tailed everywhere else (Analysis-2 matched, Analysis-3 cashspec+placebo, channel). Each table's note states its own tail, the code stars off the matching p, and every prose tail-claim matches. So this is disclosed-and-justified non-uniformity, NOT an inconsistency.
findings.robustness_note: The one-tailed HEADLINE stars also survive two-tailed, so the convention choice does not inflate reported significance: Analysis-1 residual t=0.0461/0.0172=2.68 -> two-tailed p=0.0074<0.01 (*** both tails); Analysis-1 cash t=0.0051/0.0017=3.0 -> two-tailed p=0.0027<0.01 (*** both tails).
findings.why_only_NIT: A referee may ask why one- vs two-tailed differs by table; the directional-prior rationale is stated for Analysis 1 (prose L104 'Because the hypothesis is directional') but not re-stated at the validity/reason-gating tables. Optional one-line global statement of the convention would pre-empt the question. No number or star is wrong.

p2_priority2_tail_consistency.verdict: CONSISTENT (no CRITICAL/MAJOR/MINOR). Every in-thesis table's printed stars match BOTH its own code and its own note's stated tail, and every prose tail-claim matches the code. 1 NIT (M2-02): the convention is non-uniform across tables but disclosed per-table and justified by directional priors.

p2_priority3.verdict: ONE finding (M2-03 MINOR, winsorization disclosure). Nickell = not a finding (E1). LM dictionary + clustering = MATCH.

nickell_bias.reasoning: Nickell bias afflicts the LAGGED-DV coefficient (O(1/T)) under firm FE. (a) The thesis interprets CashRatio_lag only as a partial-adjustment NUISANCE control (prose L106 'the partial-adjustment lag is 0.7990 -- cash is sticky'), not as a structural speed-of-adjustment estimand. (b) The HEADLINE uncertainty equation (UncResCEO DV) has NO lagged DV at all (R^2=0.001) -> zero Nickell exposure; only the supporting CASH equation carries CashRatio_lag. (c) The causal estimand is PreAnnounceQtr (a sparse 1.4% event indicator), weakly correlated with lagged CashRatio, so lag-coef bias does not materially propagate to it. E1: the critique binds the lag coef, which the thesis does not interpret -> no finding. Referee-anticipation note only: the draft could add one clause that the lag is an uninterpreted control and T is long (~up to 68 quarters) so any Nickell bias is negligible (seed 7b).
nickell_bias.code: lagged DV present only in cash-ratio equations (gen_empire_did add_cash_lag; empire_cashspec _lag_cell L171; matched L131). UncResCEO equations carry no lag.

findings_p2_priority3.title: Engine-level winsorization (per-year, upper-only, 99th pct) of the headline uncertainty measure + controls is undisclosed in the thesis
findings_p2_priority3.finding: The LinguisticEngine winsorizes every linguistic _pct column -- including the CEO Q&A uncertainty share that becomes UncAnsCEO and feeds the DWZ residual UncResCEO -- PER-YEAR, UPPER-TAIL-ONLY, at the 99th percentile (no lower clipping). CRSP controls are winsorized per-year 1%/99% (two-sided) and Compustat controls by their own engines. These winsorized variables feed every regression incl. Analysis 1/2/3. The thesis mentions winsorization in exactly ONE place -- the cash_scrutiny_channel table note -- which describes that table's OWN separate local re-winsor of UncAnsCEO (pooled 1/99); the engine-level scheme behind the headline residual and controls is disclosed NOWHERE (construction section L96, appendix L245-280, summary-stats note, and An.1/2/3 notes are all silent).

evidence.engine_winsor_VERIFIED_from_code: src/f1d/shared/variables/_linguistic_engine.py:331-334 -- winsorize_by_year(combined, existing_pct_cols, year_col='year', lower=0.0, upper=0.99, min_obs=10); comment L311/335 'Per-year 0%/99% (upper-only)'. winsorize_by_year (src/f1d/shared/variables/winsorization.py:79-82) clips each year-group to [quantile(lower), quantile(upper)]; lower=0.0 => clip at the per-year MINIMUM = NO bottom winsor; upper=0.99 => cap the top 1% per year. UncAnsCEO is renamed AFTER winsorization (engine L338) and/or caught by the dynamic _pct fallback (L320-321), so it IS winsorized.
